Consequently, when checking if the `spider_loader` attribute of the runner object is an instance of the custom spider loader, it fails because the actual type of `runner.spider_loader` is not as expected.

Therefore, the bug occurs due to the incorrect initialization of the spider loader in the `CrawlerRunner` class. The test failure indicates that the `SPIDER_MANAGER_CLASS` attribute is being ignored when initializing the spider loader.
